title: kraftwerk project config
description: kraftwerk.yml at the project root: config file and root marker for the kraftwerk CLI. All fields are optional — an empty file is valid.

id.description: The workspace's identity on every machine and clone: ws_ followed by 10 lowercase base36 characters. Committed with kraftwerk.yml; `kraftwerk init` writes it, `kraftwerk doctor --fix` adds a missing one.

name.description: Display name of the project ("environment"), shown in the inspector header and browser tab

slug.description: This workspace's address on this machine (<slug>.localhost, /w/<slug>/). Unique per machine. Default: the folder name. Unlike name, it changes only when you mean to move the workspace.

icon.description: Emoji used as the inspector favicon (browser-tab icon), e.g. "⚡"

color.description: Accent colour for this workspace in the switcher and the inspector, e.g. "#c2410c". Default: derived from the project root

port.description: Port `kraftwerk ui` listens on. Default: 1981 (the --port flag wins over this)

workflows.description: Workflows root relative to this file. Default: src/workflows or workflows

output.description: Run-artifact directory relative to this file. Default: output

knowledge.description: OKF knowledge-bundle root relative to this file. Default: knowledge

agents.description: Team agent-definition root relative to this file. Default: agents

skills.description: Workspace skill root (one folder per skill with a SKILL.md) relative to this file. Default: skills

switcher.description: Other kraftwerk workspaces, shown as a switcher dropdown on the workspace name in the inspector header

name.description: Display name of the other workspace

url.description: URL the other workspace's inspector runs on, e.g. "https://localhost:1985"

icon.description: Optional emoji shown next to the entry, e.g. "🛰"

git.description: Git sync for the workspace: commit and push knowledge, agents, skills and workflows from the inspector. Absent = feature off, a bare `git:` = on with defaults.

enabled.description: Turn the feature off while keeping the config. Default: true when this block exists

remote.description: Remote to fetch, pull and push. Default: origin

branch.description: Branch to sync. Default: the checked-out branch

interval.description: Seconds between background fetches (and auto-pulls). 0 disables the timer. Default: 300

autosync.description: off = fetch only. pull = also fast-forward when behind and the tree is clean. Default: pull

repos.description: Repositories: git clones the agents work on, kept under one root inside the project. Absent = feature off, a bare `repos:` = on with defaults.

enabled.description: Turn the feature off while keeping the config. Default: true when this block exists

root.description: Where clones land, relative to the project root. Should be git-ignored. Default: repos

vibeables.description: Vibeables: small apps built live in a chat with a preview pane, one folder each under the root, part of the workspace. Absent = feature off, a bare `vibeables:` = on with defaults.

enabled.description: Turn the feature off while keeping the config. Default: true when this block exists

root.description: Where the apps live, relative to the project root. Default: kraftwerk-data/vibeables

projects.description: Projects: a goal with its brief, systems of record and links to knowledge, vibeables, repositories, workflows and agents, one folder each under the root, part of the workspace. Chats scoped to a project carry all of it as context. Absent = feature off, a bare `projects:` = on with defaults.

enabled.description: Turn the feature off while keeping the config. Default: true when this block exists

root.description: Where the projects live, relative to the project root. Default: kraftwerk-data/projects

contacts.description: Contacts: people and organisations the workspace works with, one Markdown file (YAML frontmatter + notes) each under the root, part of the workspace. Referenced as contact:<slug> from projects, events and text. Absent = feature off, a bare `contacts:` = on with defaults.

enabled.description: Turn the feature off while keeping the config. Default: true when this block exists

root.description: Where the contact files live, relative to the project root. Default: kraftwerk-data/contacts

places.description: Places: addresses and points of interest, one Markdown file (YAML frontmatter + notes) each under the root, part of the workspace. Referenced as place:<slug>; a Google Maps link is derived from coordinates or the address. Absent = feature off, a bare `places:` = on with defaults.

enabled.description: Turn the feature off while keeping the config. Default: true when this block exists

root.description: Where the place files live, relative to the project root. Default: kraftwerk-data/places

events.description: Events: dated, one-off entries (a meeting, a launch, a deadline) with a place, contacts and a project, one Markdown file (YAML frontmatter + notes) each under the root, part of the workspace. Referenced as event:<slug>. Absent = feature off, a bare `events:` = on with defaults.

enabled.description: Turn the feature off while keeping the config. Default: true when this block exists

root.description: Where the event files live, relative to the project root. Default: kraftwerk-data/events

cloud.description: kraftwerk cloud: the daemon registers this MACHINE (its relay id) once, and the workspaces it serves ride along. This block only vetoes: `enabled: false` leaves this workspace out of the machine's record. The machine's switch and the cloud's origin are ~/.kraftwerk/cloud.json (`kraftwerk cloud on|off`) and KRAFTWERK_CLOUD_URL; `kraftwerk login` claims the machine.

enabled.description: false leaves this workspace out of the machine's cloud record. Default: true

url.description: Deprecated: the cloud's origin is the machine's (~/.kraftwerk/cloud.json, KRAFTWERK_CLOUD_URL). Still used, with a warning, when the machine names none.

interval.description: Deprecated and ignored: the cloud sets the heartbeat interval.
